key_insight: HMM-engineered Tamm plasmon-polaritons provide a robust solution for wide-angle high-performance photodetectors.
engineering_relevance: This work enhances photodetector performance by significantly reducing angular dispersion issues.
method: Integrated hyperbolic metamaterials with photonic crystals to tailor dispersive properties.
Used transfer matrix method and effective medium theory for analysis.
Evaluated device performance with the Fowler internal photoemission model.
evidence_signal: Achieved a normal-incidence responsivity of 17.5 mA/W with minimal decrease at high angles.
watch_item: Further exploration needed on long-term stability and efficiency under varying operational conditions.
paper_title: Wide-angle high-performance photodetector empowered by angle-insensitive Tamm plasmon polariton
